senses.gloss:
Arṇava
a work on Pkt. gr. ref. to in the Intro. verses of the Prākṛtamaṇidīpa of Appayya Dīkṣita III. MT. 4282.

Arṇava
jy. q. in Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa's own C. on his Muhūrtamārtāṇḍa, BBRAS. 321.

Arṇava
dh. Oppert II. 5160.
See Kṛtyaratnārṇava, Smṛtimahārṇava. [Page382-b]

Arṇavavarṇana
a description of the sea (?) by Śrī Harṣa, mentioned by him a. the end of Canto 9 of his Naiṣadhīyacarita.
For a suggestion that it is a description of King Arṇorāja (1139 A. D.) of the Cāhamānas of Sāmbar, see Ind. Ant. 42, p. 84.
